lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the head region. Each column contains three to four primary blobs, forming a semi-regular 2D grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs, acting as vertical axes that align the blobs into a structured grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the upper edge and shadowing immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-colored remora is attached to the ventral surface of the shark. A small yellow fish is visible in the lower-center of the frame near the pectoral fin.
